content: Ṣadr al-Dīn's Qawāʿid al-Tawḥīd treats absolute existence (wujūd muṭlaq) and tries to synthesize peripatetic and illuminationist philosophy with Ibn ʿArabian mystical theory; Ibn Turka expanded it in his commentary, al-Tamhīd fī Sharḥ Qawāʿid al-Tawḥīd (Tamhīd al-Qawāʿid), which became a staple teaching text for philosophical mysticism and the main basis of his modern reputation.
